title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00149 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Pulled riser flange above rotary Installed master bushing and elevator. Landed riser onto elevator.
00:15 - 00:45: R/u cutting machine. Cut riser.
00:45 - 01:00: R/d cutting machine.
01:00 - 01:15: L/o riser joint.
01:15 - 01:45: Pulled riser Installed master bushing and elevator. Landed riser onto elevator.
01:45 - 02:45: R/u cutting machine. Cut riser. R/d cutting machine.
02:45 - 03:00: L/o riser joint
03:00 - 03:15: Pulled riser Pulled flange through rotary, installed master and elevator. Landed riser onto elevator.
03:15 - 03:45: R/u cutting machine cut riser. R/d cutting machine.
03:45 - 04:00: L/o riser joint. Unable to move riser joint from HTS to cantilever due to wind above 40knts.
04:00 - 04:30: Pulled master bushing. Pulled riser through rotary Installer master bushing and hole cover.
04:30 - 04:45: L/o riser joint and to cantilever.
04:45 - 05:00: Changed elevator.
05:00 - 05:15: Performed TBT for r/d tension cylinders left hanging in the top mounting point.
05:15 - 07:00: Waited on weather for pulling production risers meanwhile r/d tension cylinders. Reconfigured cutter BHA and r/b in different finger 5 1/2" DP to be l/o).
07:00 - 16:30: Waited on weather for pulling production risers meanwhile continued r/d tension cylinders. Stuck pin, needed to work loose. L/o 6 joints and 35 joints 5 1/2" DP l/o 4 singles 5 1/2" HWDP cleaned pits
16:30 - 19:00: Waited on weather for pulling production risers meanwhile performed skidding checks. Performed drops inspection in derrick, STB crane pedestal, production main deck and cantilever walkways. Continued r/d tension cylinders. Lifted 3 x tension cylinders and boat collision stool from WH to drill floor. Cleaned pits cleaned shakers
19:00 - 00:00: Waited on weather for pulling production risers meanwhile continued r/d cylinders on well f-4 and f-5. Cleaned pits and shakers
